title: rosa viscaria var. nemorosa
intro:
Rosa viscaria var. nemorosa, commonly known as Wood's Rose or Alpine Rose, is a type of fragrant flowering plant belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rosa viscaria var. nemorosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities.
